changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE registration.compartments ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, external_id uuid NOT NULL, version smallint NOT NULL, created_on timestamp NOT NULL, last_update timestamp, name varchar(150) NOT NULL, type varchar(10) NOT NULL, balance numeric(15, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, description varchar(150), target_value numeric(15, 2), target_date date, id_wallet bigint NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT compartments_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT compartments_external_id_key UNIQUE (external_id), CONSTRAINT ck_compartments_on_type CHECK (type IN ('RESERVE', 'INVESTMENT', 'GOAL')), CONSTRAINT ck_compartments_on_balance CHECK (balance >= 0), CONSTRAINT ck_compartments_on_target_value CHECK (target_value IS NULL OR target_value > 0), CONSTRAINT ck_compartments_on_goal_fields CHECK ( type = 'GOAL' OR (description IS NULL AND target_value IS NULL AND target_date IS NULL) ), CONSTRAINT fk_wallets_on_compartments FOREIGN KEY (id_wallet) REFERENCES registration.wallets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_compartments_on_wallet_and_name ON registration.compartments (id_wallet, lower(name)); CREATE INDEX ix_compartments_on_type ON registration.compartments (type);

changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE financial.compartment_movements ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, external_id uuid NOT NULL, version smallint NOT NULL, created_on timestamp NOT NULL, last_update timestamp, direction varchar(10) NOT NULL, value numeric(15, 2) NOT NULL, note varchar(150), previous_balance numeric(15, 2) NOT NULL, resulting_balance numeric(15, 2) NOT NULL, id_compartment bigint NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT compartment_movements_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT compartment_movements_external_id_key UNIQUE (external_id), CONSTRAINT ck_compartment_movements_on_direction CHECK (direction IN ('DEPOSIT', 'WITHDRAWAL')), CONSTRAINT ck_compartment_movements_on_value CHECK (value > 0), CONSTRAINT fk_compartments_on_compartment_movements FOREIGN KEY (id_compartment) REFERENCES registration.compartments (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ); CREATE INDEX ix_compartment_movements_on_compartment ON financial.compartment_movements (id_compartment, created_on, id);

changeSet.author: ${claude}
${claude}
changeSet.sql: CREATE VIEW registration.wallet_totals AS SELECT wallets.id AS id_wallet, COALESCE(SUM(compartments.balance), 0) AS compartments_balance, COUNT(compartments.id) AS compartment_count, wallets.current_balance + COALESCE(SUM(compartments.balance), 0) AS total_balance FROM registration.wallets LEFT JOIN registration.compartments ON compartments.id_wallet = wallets.id GROUP BY wallets.id;
